subject.title: Gemini models output inline buttons as raw JSON text instead of using tool format

question: Should OpenClaw support a narrow raw `[[...]]` button-JSON fallback for Gemini final text, or require Gemini/provider prompting to use typed message-tool presentation buttons only?
rationale: Current source proves the observable gap, but accepting raw final-text button JSON expands the output protocol across prompt, final-reply, transcript, and Telegram presentation boundaries.

options.title: Accept Narrow Raw Fallback
options.body: Allow a constrained parser only after the linked PR or replacement is transcript-safe, rebased, and backed by redacted live Gemini-to-Telegram proof.

options.title: Retarget To Typed Routing
options.body: Reject raw final-text parsing and keep the fix focused on Gemini/tool prompting so models emit structured `message(action=send)` buttons.

options.title: Defer For Live Repro
options.body: Keep this issue open but pause implementation acceptance until a maintainer or reporter supplies a live Gemini/Telegram reproduction.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow Raw Fallback
recommendation.body: Allow a constrained parser only after the linked PR or replacement is transcript-safe, rebased, and backed by redacted live Gemini-to-Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The open linked PR requests review from `steipete`, and recent system-prompt history ties this owner candidate to the typed button guidance that the product decision affects.
